subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Viscosity: Oil's Most Important Property
description: A micro-lesson that makes Viscosity: Oil's Most Important Property usable.

hook.text: Honey pours slowly, water pours fast. The difference is viscosity.

buildup.text: Viscosity measures how much a fluid resists flow. Thicker means more drag.

discovery.text: Higher viscosity builds a stronger film but wastes more energy in drag.

twist.text: Oil gets thinner when hot. A hot engine needs oil that stays thick.

climax.text: Multi-grade oils use polymers to resist thinning at high temperature.

punchline.text: The right thickness keeps metal apart without wasting power.

quiz.question: What does a multi-grade oil like 10W-40 achieve?
options: Flows well when cold (10W) and stays thick enough when hot (40)
Contains two oils that activate at different temperatures
The numbers refer to synthetic content percentage
